selection: The measured local marginal packer uses one histogram per INT4 tensor. Exact approximation/XOR factorization saved only 23 packed bytes and did not pay its restorer. Select a distinct correlation question: condition a weight on the previous decoded weight within the same tensor row. The historical scalar-MIDAS proposal needs unresolved parent/source review and is not selected. No inference or precision mutation is needed for this synthetic test.
hypothesis: A fixed row-local preceding-weight context can reduce complete INT4 substream bytes after paying every conditional count table, relative to equivalently framed marginal coding. A positive synthetic example proves exercisability only; trained-model prevalence remains unmeasured.
controls: K: conditional histogram bookkeeping with P encoding unchanged
D: sixteen fixed histograms, preceding symbols 0..14 and row-start sentinel15
representation: Each independently terminated substream stores magic, mode, symbol count, row width, all 15-symbol uint32 count rows, and the existing Q11 range stream. D resets context at row boundaries. Decoder checks counts and canonical re-encoding. All table, framing and flush bytes count; unchanged tensor metadata and non-INT4 payloads are outside this synthetic substream comparison.
scope: Synthetic empty, singleton, dependent, independent, row-boundary and malformed streams only. No trained-model reading, corpus use, inference, source overwrite or installation.
stop_rule: One implementation and synthetic suite. Failures are implementation defects. A trained-model comparison requires separate published source/input bindings and fresh admission. No automatic candidate or full-corpus promotion; complete package remains unknown.
